segments.text: something huge rams his boat in the dark. It goes down, and all he has left is a tiny rubber raft.
Mid-Atlantic. Little solar stills and rain give him barely a pint of water a day.
Then fish gather under the raft, like it's an island. He spears them to eat.
Ship after ship sails past. Not one sees him.
Then a speared fish drives the spear into the raft and tears a hole. The raft goes soft.
Patch after patch fails. So he pushes a fork through the rubber and folds the hole shut.
He loses a third of his weight. On day {75|seventy-five}, he sees lights.
Next morning, fishermen find him, led by birds circling over the fish under his raft. The fish that fed him got him found.
